Experiment marker library

Every current event type that Respyra can send to its LSL marker outlet and the bundled RespiRecorder: 94 marker types covering setup, input, calibration, trial phases, assessments, control actions and cleanup. Which events occur depends on the run, its options and any errors.

Reference for the v0.3.9 event contract (respyra-event-markers-v1), generated from the experiment's Python catalog. Field descriptions include documentation clarifications. This public page contains event definitions; actual sent markers and counts belong to each local recording.

Payload
One JSON object per sample

One compact JSON object per LSL sample. The LSL sample timestamp equals payload.lsl_time. Record this stream together with the selected Vernier or Polar input outlet.

Advertised at desktop Python startup and retained through final Close. The default name may change during setup before subscription. Start requires the bundled native recorder to subscribe to the selected breathing input and markers and receive raw samples before acceptance or display creation. The first recorded marker embeds pre-recording setup events with their original sequence and LSL times. Recording ends after study cleanup, before the final HTML Close.

Setup history is nested in recording.started as pre_recording_events with its original sequence and LSL times. It is not a set of separate XDF samples. recording.finalizing is recorded before draining and closing the file; final HTML result and Close events occur after that recording lifetime. Optional OS keyboard/mouse markers require their recording options to be enabled.

Saved files and analysisRespyra LSL variables

Timing and alignment

Experiment screen *.shown and phase *.started markers run on the first PsychoPy display flip, directly in Python without desktop IPC. A *.dismissed marker follows the accepted key; a *.ended marker follows the phase function return. Experiment key markers are published when PsychoPy reports the key. HTML setup actions capture ui_seq/ui_time_ms before IPC and are published serially when Python consumes the action; their LSL timestamp describes backend receipt, not an exact browser paint or click timestamp. Setup shown/hidden describe form readiness and the backend accept/reject transition. Worker completion markers describe Python observing the result. No marker is emitted for every animation frame or breathing sample; record the selected raw outlet for the continuous signal. Native wrapper closure is observed at the next control/input checkpoint; forced process termination cannot finalize markers.

  • ui.prompt_control

    Python consumes Continue or Retry for one visible prompt, after its dismissal marker and any calibration retry/accept marker, before acknowledging applied. Rejected admitted commands also emit this event with accepted=false and reason stale_prompt, unavailable_control, prompt_busy, or prompt_interrupted. ui_origin/ui_client_seq identify the controller; ui_time_ms is its own clock. Authentication/schema/revision denials before the Python pipe do not emit study markers.

    Payload fields

    • prompt_id
    • accepted
    • reason
    • ui_seq

Payload dictionary

Every marker includes schema, event, run_id, seq, lsl_time, trial, condition, phase and screen. Trial/condition/phase/screen may be null. Each inventory row lists its event-specific fields. Optional HTML action metadata (ui_seq, ui_time_ms, ui_origin and ui_client_seq) is present when supplied by the controller.

accepted
Boolean: whether this key was allowed in its current input context; false also covers keys discarded at a screen transition.
accuracy
Accepted 1â€“5 performance rating for this trial.
amplitude
Comparison input calibration half-range after range scaling, in unit; Vernier uses a minimum of 0.5 N.
amplitude_n
Calculated breathing range half amplitude in Newtons; null for Polar input.
amplitude_value
Calculated breathing range half amplitude in signal_unit.
baseline_s
Configured baseline duration in seconds.
breathing_judgment
Accepted n/d/s response: normal, deeper, or shallower.
center
Comparison input calibration center, in unit, calculated from that input's accepted range samples.
center_n
Calculated force center in Newtons; null for Polar input.
center_value
Calculated breathing signal center in signal_unit.
compatible
Boolean: discovery metadata satisfies the raw Vernier Force (N) or an exact Polar signed-waveform contract; live samples are checked separately before acceptance.
conditionEvery marker
Condition name, or null outside a trial.
conditions
Condition names in the TrialHandler input list; each selected trial is marked separately.
confidence
Accepted 1â€“5 confidence rating for this trial.
control
Typed experimenter prompt command: continue (Space) or retry (R).
countdown_s
Configured countdown duration in seconds.
dot_feedback_mode
Configured visual dot feedback color mode.
enabled
Boolean recording option.
error_type
Python exception class that stopped the run.
escaped
Boolean: tracking stopped through Escape; null if tracking raised an exception.
eventEvery marker
Exact event name from the events table below.
event_lsl_time
LSL clock at OS input callback; marker lsl_time is publication time.
excluded_uids
LSL outlet UIDs explicitly excluded from native recording at Start, after removing required outlets. This identifies outlet instances, not persistent source IDs.
feedback_enabled
Boolean: whether this condition displays error-dependent dot feedback.
feedback_gain
Gain applied to the selected breathing signal about the calibrated center for this condition.
field
Setup field: participant, session, marker_name, record_keyboard or record_mouse.
flags
Windows low-level input flags.
force_channel_index
Zero-based channel index selected in the raw Vernier outlet; null for Polar input.
input_action
Windows keyboard or mouse event kind.
input_contract
Selected input contract: vernier-force/1, respyra-polar-pca/1, or respyra-polar-phan-signed/1.
input_polarity
Signed multiplier applied to a Polar waveform after the experimenter chooses inhale direction (+1 or -1); null for Vernier Force.
key
PsychoPy key name returned/discarded during the experiment; KeyboardEvent.key for HTML participant fields.
lsl_timeEvery marker
Local LSL clock at publication, in seconds. The outlet uses the same value as the LSL sample timestamp.
mean_abs_compensated_error_n
Mean absolute target-minus-displayed-force error in Newtons; null for Polar input or missing samples.
mean_abs_compensated_error_value
Mean absolute tracking error in signal_unit; null if no tracking samples were read.
message
Diagnostic error text; not a stable machine-readable code.
method
PsychoPy TrialHandler order method, such as sequential or random.
mouse_data
Windows mouse wheel/button data.
number
Countdown numeral first visible on a display flip.
origin
Connection requested through selection, remembered identity (memory), or RESPYRA_LSL_SOURCE_ID (environment).
outcome
Calibration uses result/escaped/no_data_fallback/error; tracking uses completed/escaped/error; the wrapper result uses finished/error.
participant
Participant identifier submitted in the HTML form; treat as potentially identifying research data.
phaseEvery marker
Active phase name, or null between phases.
polarity
Comparison Polar waveform's signed multiplier (+1 by default); null for Vernier Force.
policy
Native recording policy; visible_and_late_except_excluded records current and future streams except explicitly unchecked LSL UIDs.
pre_recording_events
Ordered setup marker payloads emitted before native XDF recording began. They retain their original sequence and LSL times inside recording.started; they are not separate XDF samples.
prompt_id
Run UUID and visible-prompt shown sequence. Commands apply only to this exact prompt instance.
psychopy_time
PsychoPy key timestamp if supplied by the underlying input call, in that call's clock domain; otherwise null. Use the LSL sample timestamp for cross-stream alignment.
range_cal_s
Configured range calibration duration in seconds.
range_percentiles
Two-element lower/upper percentile pair used for range clipping.
range_scale
Scale applied to the half amplitude after percentile clipping.
reason
Stable code describing an aborted trial or run.
run_idEvery marker
Random UUID shared by every marker from one Respyra run.
sample_count
Number of selected input samples contributing tracking errors; null if tracking raised before returning.
scan_code
Windows keyboard scan code.
schemaEvery marker
This catalog version.
scope
respyra_windows: only this experiment and desktop controller receive optional input markers.
screenEvery marker
Active HTML startup form or blocking PsychoPy screen identity, otherwise null.
segments
Ordered target sine segments, each with freq_hz and n_cycles.
seqEvery marker
Strictly increasing marker sequence within the run; gaps reveal missing marker samples.
session
Session identifier submitted in the HTML form.
signal_unit
Native input unit: N for Vernier Force or g for Polar waveform.
source
Experiment input API that observed or discarded the key: waitKeys, check_keys, clearEvents, local_control, or remote_control. Controller responses are semantic commands, not physical keyboard events.
source_id
Exact LSL source_id of the selected study input stream.
source_ids
Required selected input and marker source IDs subscribed by the native recorder.
stream_name
LSL name of the selected study input stream.
streams
Discovery results: list of objects with source_id, stream_name, stream_type, compatible, and reason. Rejected streams are included; compatible requires unique source_id and one exact supported input contract.
study_name
Configured human-readable study name.
subject
Three-digit BIDS-style subject label for a numeric participant, otherwise null.
target_amplitude_n
Global calibrated target sine amplitude in Newtons; null for Polar input.
target_amplitude_value
Global calibrated target sine amplitude in signal_unit.
target_center_n
Global calibrated target sine center in Newtons; null for Polar input.
target_center_value
Global calibrated target sine center in signal_unit.
task
BIDS-style task label; respyra for this study.
total_trials
Total number of trials scheduled by TrialHandler.
tracking_s
Configured tracking duration in seconds.
trialEvery marker
One-based trial number, or null outside a trial.
trials_completed
Number of trials whose feedback screen was dismissed normally.
ui_client_seq
Optional sequence within the originating browser. ui_seq orders all accepted pipe commands across both controllers.
ui_origin
Optional local or remote experiment controller origin.
ui_seq
Optional, strictly increasing HTML action sequence captured before IPC; an action can cause multiple marker events.
ui_time_ms
Optional performance.now() milliseconds captured at the local or phone HTML event callback. Each browser has a separate clock, not an LSL timestamp; do not directly align it with breathing samples.
uid
LSL outlet instance UID whose Record checkbox changed before Start.
unit
Comparison input's native unit: N for Vernier Force or g for a Polar waveform.
value
Accepted answer key for this assessment event.
variables
Original custom participant label/value pairs captured when XDF recording starts.
vk_code
Windows virtual key code.
x
Mouse screen x coordinate.
y
Mouse screen y coordinate.
y_max_n
Upper visual trace force limit in Newtons; null for Polar input.
y_max_value
Upper visual trace limit in signal_unit.
y_min_n
Lower visual trace force limit in Newtons; null for Polar input.
y_min_value
Lower visual trace limit in signal_unit.
